queryDefinition: Explicitly new size queries formed by uniform Core source scaling, EFL multiplied by scale, and declared maximum track expanded only for the 2x case. interpretation: Deterministic repeatability/integration checks, not ten independent lenses, new design success, cold-start performance or historical wide-angle improvement. The main algorithm remains frozen and unchanged.
